claim.quote: We present a measurement of the pion form factor based on e+e- annihilation data from the CMD-2 detector in the energy range 0.6<sqrt(s)<1.0 GeV with a systematic uncertainty of 0.8%.

date.locator: arXiv abstract page, submission date (hep-ex/0610021 v1, 9 October 2006)
date.note: arXiv submission date; published in Phys. Lett. B 648, 28 (2007).

key_value_text.quote: in the energy range 0.6<sqrt(s)<1.0 GeV with a systematic uncertainty of 0.8%
key_value_text.value: Pion form factor measured for 0.6 < √s < 1.0 GeV with 0.8% systematic uncertainty

name: High-statistics measurement of the pion form factor in the rho-meson energy range with the CMD-2 detector
notes: The muon g-2 topic tag reflects the use of the pion form factor in that calculation; the abstract itself does not mention g-2.

summary.plain: CMD-2 measured the pion form factor, which describes how electron-positron collisions make pion pairs, between 0.6 and 1.0 GeV with a 0.8% systematic uncertainty from a data sample five times larger than its previous measurement.
summary.technical: CMD-2 at VEPP-2M: pion form factor from e⁺e⁻ → π⁺π⁻ for 0.6 < √s < 1.0 GeV with a systematic uncertainty of 0.8%; the data sample is five times larger than in the previous CMD-2 measurement (Phys. Lett. B 648 (2007) 28).

title: High-statistics measurement of the pion form factor in the rho-meson energy range with the CMD-2 detector
why_it_matters: The abstract reports the result as a measurement of the pion form factor with a systematic uncertainty of 0.8%.
